prompt:
Premium handmade cut-paper collage: layered construction paper, cardstock and cozy felt with visible fiber texture, softly rounded scissor-cut edges, slight handmade imperfections, tiny stitched details, real button holes and twisted yarn fibers, and soft tactile shadows between stacked layers. Saturated coral, marigold, teal, leaf green, plum and sky blue on warm cream. Child-safe preschool proportions, handmade warmth. No vector art, no glossy plastic, no text unless the prompt explicitly requests the title.

A precise four-column by two-row preschool craft asset sheet on one perfectly flat uniform dark-charcoal background. Exactly eight separate real-feeling nature treasures, one centered inside each equal invisible cell with generous charcoal margin, consistent top-down camera and soft studio light, no overlap. Reading order: coral-red pressed maple leaf; golden-yellow pressed oak leaf; fresh green fern frond; white pressed daisy with yellow center; small pressed sky-blue flower; slim forked brown twig; little brown acorn with textured cap; small warm-brown pinecone. Preserve natural surface detail while making every item friendly, clean, and easy to recognize. No cell borders, labels, text, letters, hands, containers, duplicates, shadows crossing cells, or extra objects.
